title: Cloud VPN and Interconnect: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Your factory has sites in two cities. They need a road between them. There are two kinds of road.

scenes.heading: The two city factory
scenes.narration: Google offers a cheap road and a fast road. Cloud V P N is encrypted, over the public internet. Cloud Interconnect is a private dedicated connection. Choose Interconnect for high performance. Many firms use V P N as a backup.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Interconnect is faster. It bypasses the internet. They're often combined.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva GCP hybrid lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. V P N is encrypted over the internet. Interconnect is private and fast. Use both for resilience. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva GCP hybrid lab.
